gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Cuyahoga Falls Historical Society began on November 7, 1979. Members consisted of Ray Sutliff, William Barth, John Bender, Connie Jenkins, John Wafer, Ione Hoffman, Virginia Bloetscher, and Nina Perkins. Eric Thompson, columnist for the Falls News Press and local historian spoke at this inaugural event.
